learning_outcomes.text: Understand the fundamental relationships governing electric circuits
Employ circuit analysis techniques to solve series, parallel and series parallel dc and ac circuits
Understand the different powers in ac circuits and perform calculations
Explain the operating principles of single-phase transformers and perform calculation to determine the operating efficiency of transformers

syllabus_topics: Introduction to electric fields, permittivity, Capacitance, impedance of a capacitor
Introduction to magnetic fields, self and mutual inductance, impedance of an inductor
Alternating current fundamentals, period, frequency and angular frequency
Application of complex numbers in simple ac circuits
Resonance in simple series ac circuits
Series RLC circuit as a band-pass filter
RC circuits as low-pass and high pass filters
Circuit analysis techniques, steady-state dc and ac circuit analysis
assessment_rules: Continuous assessment consists of a series of closed book, timed, on-line tests. The overall weight for these tests is 100%.
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
